mapper.sql: B.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, B.BID_PBANC_NO AS bidPbancNo, B.PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, B.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, C.CD_NM AS pbancSttsNm, B.LMT_PAGE_CNT AS lmtPageCnt, NVL(B.DMND_INST_NM, B.ORDER_INST_NM) AS instNm, B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN AS sprvsnTeamSn, ST.TEAM_NM AS sprvsnTeamNm, (SELECT LISTAGG(PT.TEAM_NM, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY PT.TEAM_NM) FROM TB_PTCP_TEAM P JOIN TB_TEAM PT ON PT.TEAM_SN = P.TEAM_SN WHERE P.PBANC_SN = B.PBANC_SN) AS ptcpTeamNms
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM ST ON ST.TEAM_SN = B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE B.PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040', 'PS050', 'PS060') ORDER BY B.PBANC_SN DESC
SELECT FROM TB_BID_PBANC B LEFT JOIN TB_COM_CD C ON C.GROUP_CD = 'PBSTS' AND C.CD = B.PBANC_STTS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_TEAM ST ON ST.TEAM_SN = B.SPRVSN_TEAM_SN WHERE B.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}

SELECT B.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, B.PBANC_STTS_CD AS pbancSttsCd, B.SBMSN_DT AS sbmsnDt, B.PRSNR_ID AS prsnrId, U.USER_NM AS prsnrNm FROM TB_BID_PBANC B LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = B.PRSNR_ID WHERE B.PBANC_SN = #{pbancSn}
mapper.sql: D.DCMNT_SN AS dcmntSn, D.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, D.DCMNT_NM AS dcmntNm, D.ESNTL_YN AS esntlYn, D.TKCG_SE_CD AS tkcgSeCd, D.PRGRS_STTS_CD AS prgrsSttsCd, D.SBMSN_DDLN_DT AS sbmsnDdlnDt, D.RMRK_CN AS rmrkCn, F.FILE_SN AS fileSn, F.RGTR_ID AS fileRgtrId, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.FILE_SZ AS fileSz, FU.USER_NM AS fileRgtrNm, F.REG_DT AS fileRegDt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE X WHERE X.DCMNT_SN = D.DCMNT_SN AND X.DEL_YN = 'N') AS fileCnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE X WHERE X.DCMNT_SN = D.DCMNT_SN) AS fileTotal

FROM TB_SBMSN_DCMNT D LEFT JOIN TB_ATCH_FILE F ON F.FILE_SN = (SELECT MAX(X.FILE_SN) FROM TB_ATCH_FILE X WHERE X.DCMNT_SN = D.DCMNT_SN AND X.DEL_YN = 'N') LEFT JOIN TB_USER FU ON FU.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SBMSN_DCMNT (PBANC_SN, DCMNT_NM, ESNTL_YN, TKCG_SE_CD, PRGRS_STTS_CD, SBMSN_DDLN_DT) VALUES (#{pbancSn}, #{dcmntNm}, #{esntlYn}, #{tkcgSeCd}, 'DS010', #{sbmsnDdlnDt, jdbcType=DATE})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SBMSN_DCMNT SET PRGRS_STTS_CD = #{prgrsSttsCd} WHERE DCMNT_SN = #{dcmntSn}
UPDATE TB_SBMSN_DCMNT SET SBMSN_DDLN_DT = #{sbmsnDdlnDt, jdbcType=DATE} WHERE DCMNT_SN = #{dcmntSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ATCH_FILE (PBANC_SN, FILE_SE_CD, DCMNT_SN, VER_NO, LAST_YN, ORGNL_FILE_NM, STRG_FILE_NM, FILE_PATH_NM, FILE_SZ, FILE_EXTN_NM, MEMO_CN, RGTR_ID) VALUES (#{f.pbancSn}, #{f.fileSeCd}, #{dcmntSn, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{f.verNo}, 'N', #{f.orgnlFileNm}, #{f.strgFileNm}, #{f.filePathNm}, #{f.fileSz}, #{f.fileExtnNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{f.memoCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{f.rgtrId})
mapper.sql: F.FILE_SN AS fileSn, F.PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, F.FILE_SE_CD AS fileSeCd, F.TOC_SN AS tocSn, F.VER_NO AS verNo, F.ORGNL_FILE_NM AS orgnlFileNm, F.STRG_FILE_NM AS strgFileNm, F.FILE_PATH_NM AS filePathNm, F.FILE_SZ AS fileSz, F.FILE_EXTN_NM AS fileExtnNm, F.MEMO_CN AS memoCn, F.RGTR_ID AS rgtrId, U.USER_NM AS rgtrNm, F.REG_DT AS regDt, F.DEL_YN AS delYn, F.DLTR_ID AS dltrId, X.USER_NM AS dltrNm, F.DEL_DT AS delDt, F.DEL_RSN AS delRsn, CASE WHEN F.FILE_SE_CD = 'FL060' THEN '조견표' ELSE DC.DCMNT_NM END AS targetNm
FROM TB_ATCH_FILE F LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = F.RGTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER X ON X.USER_ID = F.DLTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SBMSN_DCMNT DC ON DC.DCMNT_SN = F.DCMNT_SN
mapper.select:
